name: MLflow Platform Model
description: This specification describes how to define models from MLflow - An open source platform for the machine learning lifecycle, including experimentation, reproducibility, deployment, and central model registry. Supports models from various frameworks including scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, XGBoost, and more.
modelDataSheet: The URL to the location of the model data sheet (model card)
deploymentRecord: The URL to the artifact or the location of the deployment record
inheritedModel: The URL to the artifact or the location of the inherited model
modelEvaluationData: The URL to the artifact or the location of the model evaluation data
modelTrainingData: The URL to the artifact or the location of the model training data

specCharacteristic.name: platformUrl
specCharacteristic.description: MLflow model registry URL where model is registered

specCharacteristic.name: apiUrl
specCharacteristic.description: MLflow REST API endpoint for model version operations

specCharacteristic.name: modelType
specCharacteristic.description: MLflow model flavor (e.g., sklearn, tensorflow, pytorch, xgboost, etc.)

specCharacteristic.name: supportedLibraries
specCharacteristic.description: Machine learning framework or library used to create the model

specCharacteristic.name: provider
specCharacteristic.description: User or organization that registered the model in MLflow

specCharacteristic.name: deploymentArtifactsUrl
specCharacteristic.description: URL to download model artifacts in tar.gz format

specCharacteristic.name: totalSize (in bytes)
specCharacteristic.description: Total size of model artifacts in bytes

specCharacteristic.name: tags
specCharacteristic.description: Tags and metadata associated with the model
